_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The Z2 front captain: Vanguard at cL15, the deepest-gated teaching in the world. ⚑ Q4 SHAPE (conversation-journal §4.6, R1): greeting at root, the war-banner briefing an answer-node, the teaching a named row.
name: FrontCaptain

lines: You've walked far enough south to be useful. Good.

options.text: How do I bring down the Orc Commander?
Teach me to hold a line.

grants.line: You look strong! We could use your help in the war. Take this.

lines: Not while his war banners stand — steel won't touch him.
Break the banners in his camp west of here. Then bring him down.
